content: NGU YAGULA JON KIYANDA VAK
Wan njɨmbla Galilina njambwi nyan Herot Jisas kwuta njɨvwa kat wutndɨ. Wutaa wandɨ.
Ndɨ nambu kalɨkwa ngu yagu la Jon. Kiyalaa lɨga laatndɨ. Kiyalaa lɨga laataa kwondu klalaa wan nɨma njɨvwa kwutɨgandɨ waa ndɨna kwupmba la nɨmba kat wandɨ.
Tat Herot wandɨ maa Jon kat kwutaa man taamba sangilaa kalabusmba taagandi, lɨndɨ. Herotna yakwa nyan Filipna taagwa Herodias walɨ maa Jon kat kalabusmba taaga waa wandɨ Herot.
Tak ngu yagula Jon yalaa Herot kat walɨndɨ. Mɨna yakwa nyana taagwa sɨkwuka klama vat ana nglaatndɨ. Ndɨ ana wundumbu yindɨ. Kwo lɨgandɨ waa walɨndɨ maa

Herot ndɨ kat vatnyavak kat yelavɨka lɨndɨ. Nɨma sakwat Juda ndi yelavɨtndi. Ndɨ ngu yagu lɨga Jon God waa nyaangɨt mbutɨga profetna waa yelavɨka lɨndi. Herot ndi kat vaaka lɨga Jon kat ana vatnyandɨ.

Herot kat kwutnja nandinya nɨma kɨgɨnda kwutndɨ. Kwutaa wandɨ, nɨma sakwat nɨmba yandi kwutnda kɨgɨnda kɨvak. Yandi maa Herodiasna taagwa nyan laataa mbangu veilɨlɨ maa vɨga lɨndi. Herot vɨga lɨga mbangu veila vak kat woviyaguga lɨga wandɨ.
Klavat wanyeya nda wun kat mbukiyanyɨn. Nyɨn kat kwigiyowun. Woseka ana wowun wawa wandɨ Herot.
Lɨ yiga nyɨme kat wagalalaa yaa Herot kat walɨ. Ngu yagu la Jona nambu kalɨtaa wun kat yaanjɨmba taagalaa agwi walɨ.
Herot wutaa Jona nambu kalɨpmak kat ndɨna mbangɨ kɨlɨp mbangɨ yindɨ. Woseka ana wowun waa wanda vat aywaa wumba la nɨmba wutndi. Ngi kat tɨga wandɨ maa
yiga kalabusmba lɨndɨ, ndɨna nambu kalɨtndi.
Nambu kalɨtaa yaanjɨmba taagalaa Herodiasna taagwa nyan kat kwindi. Wan yaanjɨmba taagalaa kwinja nmbu klalaa nyɨmeat yiga kwilɨ.
Jona mbaapmamba la nɨmba nambu kalɨtnda vak kat wutaa yalaa Jona sɨm klalaa yiga waangumba valaa taagandi. Taagalaa Jisas kat yiga mbutndi.
JISAS 5,000 TA NƗMBA KAT KƗGƗNDA KWINDƗ
Mbutndi maa wutaa Jisas wan kava kwagalalaa ndinyangu lapman kavat njaambɨt kulaa yindɨ. Yinda vat wutaa nɨma sakwat nɨmba laataa ndɨ kat vɨvat yindi nɨmbumba.
Kawiga lɨga yanja vak kat vɨndɨ. Ndi kat vɨlaa miwa yiga lɨndi. Miwa yiga lɨga ndina yelogwen kat ta nɨmba kat kwunatndɨ.
Wan nglaambu ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba yalaa Jisas kat wandi. Kan kava kwo kava kɨgɨnda klaneya kava kai. Ngan lamba ndaiveigandɨ. Wamɨn maa ngepmat yilaa kɨgɨnda klaandi waa wandi.
Wandi maa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ndi ana yigiyandi. Ngwuk ndi kat kɨgɨnda agwi ngwula waa wandɨ maa
wandi. Nɨma kɨgɨnda nɨma sakwat ana lɨgandɨ. Nao tambanat kami vɨlɨlɨk mɨna lɨgandɨ waa wandi.

Wandi maa Jisas wandɨ. Wan nao kɨgɨnda agwi ngwula wuna lak waa walaa nɨma sakwat nɨmba kat vɨlaa ngwuk yuwimba ndaa alɨ ngwula waa walaa wan nao kɨgɨnda klalaa tanambɨka vɨlaa God kat sɨvu kɨlaa wan nao tambɨ lambɨ lɨmbaga ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba kat kwindɨ. Ndi yiga wan nɨma sakwat nɨmba kat kwindi.
Kɨlɨndi, yaat taatɨ. Kɨlambɨga kwagalanja nao kɨgɨnda aposel mbanimba tamba vɨli kiyeli vɨlɨlɨkmba naagandi.
Ka ndi nɨmbana sakwat 5,000 nɨmba. Taagwa nyangu kat ana sɨga nagundi. Ndu mɨna sɨga nagundi.
JISAS TAGU NGUMBA VEIGA YALƗNDI
Jisas ndɨna kwupmba la nɨmba kat wandɨ. Njaambɨt kulaa yindi maa wan ndɨnai la kavamba la nɨma sakwat nɨmba kat wandɨ. Ngwuk ngepma ay ngwula wandɨ, yindi.
Yindi maa God kat nyaangɨt ngambuvat nduwiat wokendɨ. Wumba kapma lɨndɨ, ngan ndandɨ.
Ngan ndandɨ, kulaa yinja njaambɨt nɨndɨ sapmba lɨndɨ maa mwuk ndina ndaama njaambɨpmba viyalɨndɨ, nɨma pali laataa kiyalɨndɨ.
Ngambi ngan Jisas tagu ngumba veiga ndi kat vɨvat yalɨndɨ.
Ndɨna kwupmba la nɨmba ndɨ kat vɨlaa vaaka kɨselaga wundumba yalɨga waa walɨndi.
Jisas ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwula maawut ke nɨmamba yelavɨka vakngwa. Wun Jisas wun yaa ngwuk kat vɨvat waa wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa wutaa Pita ndɨ kat wandɨ. Njambwi nyan mɨnayɨ? Mɨna lat tɨmeyan wun kat wamɨn maa ngu tagumba veiga mɨnai lɨga kavat yalu wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa Jisas yagwa wandɨ. Pita njaambɨt kwagalalaa ngu tagumba veiga yilɨndɨ.
Yiga lɨga mwuk pali kat vɨlaa vaaka yelavɨtaa lumaka ndaivat yindɨ. Lumaka ndaivat tɨga wandɨ. Njambwi nyan wun kat yaa kwutaa katso wandɨ.
Jisas yalaa ndɨ kat taambamba kwutaa katsolaa wandɨ. Mɨnai yelavɨka lɨga vat nɨma ana ndɨ. manda kat vapmɨn. Vapmangat tɨga lumaka ndaivat yimɨn waa wandɨ maa
mbɨt njaambɨt yiga kumbɨt. kumbɨt maa kwuta mwuk pali kiyak wandɨ.
Kiyak wanda vak kat vɨlaa ndɨna mbaapmamba la nɨmba Jisasna sɨ kwutaa katsoga wandi. mɨn Godna nyan mɨn waa wandi.
GENESARETMBA LA YELOGWEN KAT TA NƗMBA KAT JISAS KWUNATNDƗ
Njaambɨpmba valɨgelaa Genesaret walɨnja ngempamba kawindi.
Kawindi maa wan ngepmamba la nɨmba Jisasna mɨndama vɨlaa yanda vak yiga mbutndi. Mbutndi maa ngepma ngepmamba yelogwen kat ta nɨmba kat aywaa kwutaa kiyandi.
Yelogwen kat ta nɨmba ndɨna waavwina njɨmbwi waavwi sɨnyɨpmak kat wagalandi. njɨmbwi waavwi sɨnyɨta nɨmba yelogwen kat ta nɨmba ndi kwo lɨndi.
